0022600208.text: The Rockets (7-2, 4-1 at home) come into this home game 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West, but they have lost their most recent game, while the Nuggets (5-3) are 9th in the West, 4th in the Northwest and 1.5 games back, and have won their last two. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Denver will be without Julian Strawther (knee sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Rockets lost the season series 1-3, including a 129-93 loss in Denver on March 11, 2026.
